fieldData.acrm---key-feature-4-content:
Holds set by the answers

Hold a booking when an answer needs a conversation first, such as a recent operation. The lead therapist hears about it in Slack or by email before the client arrives.
fieldData.awb---integration-feature-2:
Deep tissue waits for a call after recent knee surgery

Kestrel Sports Massage books deep tissue online, and its intake asks for the date of any surgery in the last 12 weeks. A runner who reports knee surgery 6 weeks ago keeps her slot, but it stays on hold. Owen Tate, the lead therapist, gets a Slack message to call her and confirms the booking after they talk.
fieldData.awb---mockup-data: window.awbMockup = { soloTherapists: "I run a one-person massage practice. Build an intake form that opens with each regular's answers from their last visit already filled in, so they confirm or edit them. Highlight anything they change, such as a new medication or an injury, at the top of my session sheet for that appointment. New clients get the full form with pressure, areas to avoid and a signature.", daySpas: "My day spa needs a massage intake form that asks every guest about pregnancy and, if the answer is yes, how many weeks along. Move any pregnant guest off the general Swedish booking and onto the schedule of a therapist trained in prenatal massage. Add a note to the room asking for a side-lying setup with extra pillows.", sportsMassage: "My sports massage clinic books deep tissue sessions online. Ask every client for the date of any surgery in the last 12 weeks. If there is one, keep the slot but put it on hold, and send our lead therapist a Slack message to call the client. The booking is confirmed only after he marks the call done.", chairMassage: "I run chair massage at office wellness days. Build a short intake employees open from a QR code on their phones: three screening questions, areas to avoid and a signature. Each signed form should take the next open 15-minute slot, and the therapist needs a list on a tablet showing everyone in order with their areas to avoid." };
